name: CALLING CARD
source:
"No man is a hero to his valet---no man is a supervillain to his own henchperson."

CALLING CARD is a Kinetic Novel in which you play as a henchperson tasked with helping out their boss. Listen closely and read between the lines, and you might just find out something new about him.

[from [url=https://hopjam.itch.io/calling-card]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“没有人对他的仆人来说是英雄，也没有人对自己的追随者来说是超级恶棍。”

《CALLING CARD》是一部动感小说，你在其中扮演一名追随者，负责帮助他们的老板。仔细聆听并阅读字里行间，你可能会发现一些关于他的新东西。

[来自[url=https://hopjam.itch.io/calling-card]itch.io[/url]]
